title: I made Jimothysjourney.com with Open ai assets and Claude code (Fable 5) with Lovable architecture
author: DuchessCupcakeGames
selftext:
I had to get this out there while Jimothy was still hot and I think I caught the wave just at the right moment. Not to mention the gameplay is legitimately fun (if I do say so myself!) The game mechanics were all my design with help from my creative team (my 8yo son.) 

I designed it early on to handle expansions over time, with new maps that lazy load so they don't break the game the more I expand. I've been adding quests to each area that I design with Claude for code and Chat gpt for assets, then I use my free 5 credits a day with Lovable to put it all together. This game so far has been surprisingly easy to make and the ideas just flow out every time my son and I play it. 

The latest addition is including "Daddy Devito" the fabled father of Jimothy upon the discovery of a second, older short spine syndrome raccoon rumored to be Jimothy's progenitor. He teaches Jimothy how to flip out of danger, and he gains a new skill. 

I've had about 500 people so far check it out since creating it 12 days ago! If you love Jimothy and like simulator adventure games where you play Jimothy, play Jimothysjourney.com today!

comments.author: ElwinLewis
comments.body: Hey I think this is awesome, and your son is definitely going to remember making this with you. In the future, he 'll wonder why the meme was as funny as it was, but he'll never wonder if his dad enjoyed spending time with him.
